gloss: can't take one's eyes off, captivating

definitions.explanation: Describes something so interesting or beautiful that one cannot stop watching.

definitions.gloss: requires constant attention, can't leave unattended
definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something that needs continuous watching for safety reasons.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{目|め}が{離|はな}せない。
examples.english: This movie is so captivating I can't look away.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}のダンスから{目|め}が{離|はな}せなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't take my eyes off her dance.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}の{展開|てんかい}が{面白|おもしろ}くて、{最後|さいご}まで{目|め}が{離|はな}せなかった。
examples.english: The game was so interesting that I couldn't look away until the very end.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}{最|もっと}も{目|め}が{離|はな}せない{若手|わかて}{選手|せんしゅ}だ。
examples.english: He's the most captivating young player right now.

examples.japanese: {舞台|ぶたい}の{上|うえ}で{踊|おど}る{彼女|かのじょ}は{美|うつく}しくて、{一瞬|いっしゅん}も{目|め}が{離|はな}せなかった。
examples.english: She was so beautiful dancing on stage that I couldn't look away for even a moment.

examples.japanese: {小|ちい}さい{子供|こども}からは{目|め}が{離|はな}せない。
examples.english: You can't take your eyes off small children.

examples.japanese: {今後|こんご}の{動向|どうこう}から{目|め}が{離|はな}せない。
examples.english: We need to keep a close eye on future developments.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が{病気|びょうき}で、{一日中|いちにちじゅう}{目|め}が{離|はな}せない。
examples.english: The cat is sick, so I can't take my eyes off it all day.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{歩|ある}き{始|はじ}めたので、{前|まえ}よりもっと{目|め}が{離|はな}せなくなった。
examples.english: The baby started walking, so I have to watch even more carefully than before.

examples.japanese: この{患者|かんじゃ}は{容態|ようだい}が{不安定|ふあんてい}で、しばらく{目|め}が{離|はな}せない{状態|じょうたい}が{続|つづ}く。
examples.english: This patient's condition is unstable, and they'll need constant attention for a while.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {目|め} (eye) + が + {離|はな}せない (cannot release). Literally 'cannot release one's eyes.'

TWO NUANCES:
1. Positive: Something is so fascinating you want to keep watching
2. Practical: Something requires attention for safety/caution

CONTRAST:
- {目|め}が{離|はな}せない: eyes stay fixed (passive attraction or need)
- {目|め}を{離|はな}す: to look away, take one's eyes off
- {手|て}が{離|はな}せない: hands are occupied (busy doing something)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {釘付|くぎづ}けになる (to be riveted, nailed in place)
- {見入|みい}る (to gaze at, be absorbed in watching)
